KPDM.official_code: No official implementation identified in the inspected paper or searches; implementation limited to disclosed adaptations.

RSTPReid.rights: Built from MSMT17. Repository MIT license does not establish rights to redistribute pedestrian images publicly.

vendor_changes: One Chinese code comment translated into English; no functional changes.
architecture_deviations: Strict pretrained load instead of upstream silent load errors.
Clean captions isolated from masking (upstream NumPy aliasing corrected).
training_deviations: AdamW with no bias/LN decay, instead of default upstream Adam.
Validation-only early stopping rather than upstream default test monitoring.
Explicitly authorized quarantine of four cross-split duplicate training images.
Explicit BF16 autocast after the initial FP16 GPU profile produced scaled-gradient overflow; FP32 loss calculations retained.
masking_adaptations: Versioned visual lexicon rather than SpaCy POS tags.
Whole-span token budget with measured overshoot and explicit no-candidate zero MLM.
KPDM-inspired top-25 training BPE frequency weights, f=count/total, exponent2, floor0.05.
